description: OOS enabled group is paused and labelled
API error -> no action
empty response is not OOS
stale read (8 h) -> no action
kill switch -> no action
manual pause is never auto-enabled
new group created PAUSED for review is never labelled or enabled
first IN_STOCK read only waits
item missing from read -> alert, not OOS
identity outside SK (feed_label AT) ignored even if offer_id equal
non-allowlisted object untouched
mass flip >30% halts the run
manually enabled while labelled -> only remove stale label
PREORDER/BACKORDER never auto-enable
full resource_name is parsed and acted on (OOS -> PAUSE)
unknown identity format -> ALERT, no action
sync-hold on a sync-paused group blocks enable
sync-hold on an enabled OOS group blocks pause
manual enable WITHOUT hold does not authorise OOS advertising -> PAUSE
paused with UNKNOWN owner is never enabled
owner SYNC but label missing -> treated as unknown, no enable
read timestamp in the future -> ALERT
read without read_id -> ALERT
stale upstream time even with fresh fetch -> no action
idempotent: same input after commit -> 0 actions
replaying the same read adds no confirmation
second distinct fresh read (unchanged IN_STOCK) enables
distinct read below minimum interval does not confirm
HALT: no actions, no proposed state, input unchanged
failed apply -> stored confirmations not advanced
